topic: Religion & Ethics: Applied Ethics (Euthanasia, Business Ethics, Sexual Ethics)
subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do all religions believe the same about life after death?
items.correct: No — beliefs differ (e.g. resurrection, reincarnation, or other views).
items.misconception: Yes, all believe exactly the same.
items.why: Concepts of the afterlife vary significantly between traditions.

items.q: Are religious views on medical ethics (e.g. abortion, euthanasia) uniform?
items.correct: No — they vary within and between religions.
items.random_wrong: Religions have no views on medical ethics.
items.why: Believers apply principles like the sanctity of life differently.
